gap: Scoping PASSED (0 of 5,184,000 px differ vs a same-session shots.mjs baseline), so this verdict is design, not leakage. The Customers list genuinely beats Wave: even 72px rows, bold #101828 name column, calm #f1f4f9 header band. But the money surface loses on the bar's own terms. /invoice at 1440x900: (1) currency glyphs do not align - the Paid column renders '$', number and 'USD' as inline siblings in a text-align:right cell, so the '$' sits at x=969.2 on seven rows and x=1000.2 on the '$ 0.000' row, a 31px break in what must be a straight ledger edge; (2) the Client column is pinned at 123px, laddering 'Vertex Design Studio' / 'Harbour Coffee Roasters' / 'Delta Logistics Group' onto 3 lines and alternating row heights 73.6px / 93.9px, versus Wave's dead-even single-line cadence; (3) an amber 'No Payment' warning fires on all 10 of 10 rows including rows whose Status is 'Paid' and whose Paid equals Total, so every row shouts a contradiction where Wave's rows are silent; (4) 171px of columns (Payment + actions) are clipped behind the sticky-right column with only a 6%-alpha 30px gradient as the cue. Doubled '$' and 'USD' notation on every amount compounds it. Fix the money cell to a fixed-width currency gutter, widen Client to one line, and gate the payment badge on actual balance.
